resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Service list and two lookout-history sites date a 1915 crow's nest to this area. Louis Hartig's 1981 history for the Lochsa district describes a 1939 observation station with no structures ever built at the point and does not mention 1915. The story reports both accounts and does not choose one.

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on whether a structure existed. Three sources give a 1915 crow's nest; the 1981 Hartig history says the point was used as an observation station from 1939 and that no structure was ever built there. The record's kind 'platform' and status 'gone' are not contradicted outright, but the 1981 account suggests a camp rather than a built platform; the editor may want to revisit the kind. The Gold Meadows entry on the A-L page is the source of the 1939 observer line. The trail source is a commercial trail app, used only for the fact that the trail passes the mountain. No access level is supported, so none is set.
